title: muninn tasks --json
description: What only the user can do, kept once. A task's key is the id of the message that created it (or muninn:<n> for Muninn's own); n is its short display number (T-n). Open tasks by default; --all for every status, --project to filter by origin. New fields may be added within v1; a renamed field or a changed meaning is v2.

links.description: "new": its project said why it is new (new_reason); "deadline:<domain>/<id>": a plan deadline it settles; "task:<key>": the settled task it repeated.

ref.description: The origin's message id; messages about this task may use it.
